dataset: Deck and season names, and who uses which
why: Every source names the same decks differently, and this site has twice published a wrong count of one deck’s names. This file is the running record so the next page does not have to guess. See DATA.md.

sources_key.players: player posts seen in keyword searches

decks.key_card: 超神星HADES・ドラゲリオン
decks.warning: The ranked season running to 15 October is also named after this card, so a keyword search on the name returns posts about the season, not the deck.

names.name: 火水闇ダピコ
names.note: "Dapico", glossed by the column as D.A.P.I. — after an idol character, not the finisher.

names.name: クローシスダピコ
names.note: Seen 27 September and 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 and 12 October. This site missed it while publishing two pages that counted the names.

names.name: クローシスダピコハデス
names.note: One Minogami Cup opponent list, 12 October. Welds three of the others together.

names.name: 青黒魔導具
names.note: A second entry the survey splits out on some days; same family, not a different deck.

names.name: キャベッジバラギアラ
names.note: A second entry from 4 October. Reading the loop line alone makes that day look like a 6.3-point collapse; the family fell 2.1.

names.name: ジョラゴンジョーカーズ
names.note: The survey’s own name until 27 September.

names.name: ジョーカーズ
names.note: Renamed by the survey on 27 September; same line.

seasons.name_official: HADES・ドラゲリオンカップ
seasons.note: Not on the news index. Named after a card that is also a deck name, which contaminates keyword searches on that name.
